intent: Point-lookup KV workload (single-table PK reads, no joins, high calls_per_second); DynamoDB ideal for the general PK reads, ElastiCache ideal for the ephemeral session read, and each engine is an acceptable fallback for the other's queries.

q_get_by_pk.rationale: Single-table PK point read on users, high RPS — canonical DynamoDB shape.

q_get_cart.rationale: Single-table PK point read on carts, high RPS — canonical DynamoDB shape.

q_session_get.rationale: Ephemeral session lookup by session_id — canonical ElastiCache shape.
